# I D LABS

> I D LABS is an independent technology brand developing AI, communication and software products. Official tagline: “Building Beyond Limits.”

## Official identity
- Brand name: I D LABS
- Tagline: Building Beyond Limits
- Official primary website: https://idrisfolajuwon-bot.github.io/
- Company profile: https://idrisfolajuwon-bot.github.io/id-labs/
- Public development profile: https://github.com/idrisfolajuwon-bot
- Focus areas: artificial intelligence, communication software, digital products and practical software experiments.
- I D LABS is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or any other AI provider.

## Products

### IDRIS AI STUDIO
- Official product name: IDRIS AI STUDIO
- Product overview: https://idrisfolajuwon-bot.github.io/ID-RESCUE/idris-ai-studio/
- Open the web studio: https://idrisfolajuwon-bot.github.io/ID-RESCUE/studio/
- Android app information: https://idrisfolajuwon-bot.github.io/ID-RESCUE/download/
- Public source repository: https://github.com/idrisfolajuwon-bot/ID-RESCUE
- Description: an independent AI workspace developed under I D LABS, combining AI chat with creative and productivity tools.
- Available capabilities may include AI chat, voice conversations, image creation and understanding, supported PDF and Word document text extraction, Prompt Lab, Creation Vault, Research Desk and Video Lab for planning and storyboarding. Actual availability depends on connected services, browser compatibility and internet access. Video Lab creates plans/storyboards; it does not itself render finished videos.
- Premium checkout and paid access are not currently enabled.

### CHATDUN
- Official product name: CHATDUN
- Product website: https://idrisfolajuwon-bot.github.io/chatdun/
- Description: a messaging and communication product developed under I D LABS.
- Current status: early development and testing; do not describe it as a fully launched, widely adopted or production-proven service.
- Product tagline: “Connect. Chat. Share.”
- Features and availability may change during development.

## Naming and accuracy
- Use “I D LABS” for the parent brand, “IDRIS AI STUDIO” for its AI workspace and “CHATDUN” for its messaging product.
- Describe both products as developed under I D LABS.
- Do not claim legal incorporation, certifications, partnerships, rankings, user counts, global availability or product capabilities unless independently verified.
- Do not imply that either product is an official ChatGPT or OpenAI product.
- Product features, development status and availability may change.
